name: Salary slip conserves quantity = net_pay = gross_pay - total_deductions in pure currency

payload.rationale: Every salary slip is a monetary commitment (unit == null, currency != null) conserving exact decimal net pay (net_pay == gross_pay - total_deductions >= 0) and matching its REA Commitment quantity (quantity == net_pay; HR-PR-01, HR-PR-04).

response.expression: ((((((self.gross_pay >= 0) and (self.total_deductions >= 0)) and (self.net_pay == (self.gross_pay - self.total_deductions))) and (self.net_pay >= 0)) and (self.quantity == self.net_pay)) and (self.unit == null)) and (self.currency != null)

payload.subject: hr.SalarySlip
